summary.en: During the night of the Tenkaichi Festival at the Okeyama Hotel, an author named Satoru Imatake is brushing his teeth in the bathroom, and his friend, Norikazu Sasai is making a mess. When he checks on Sasai, he is confused about Sasai being dressed up weird, and sees that the hotel room was a big mess. Sasai raises his gun to aim at Imatake's forehead and shoots him. He also takes his money from his wallet.
